export_array_ascii.longname: export array variables to layered ascii files.
export_array_ascii.description: keyword that specifies input griddata arrays should be written to layered ascii output files.

strt.description: is the initial (starting) stage---that is, stage at the beginning of the SWF Model simulation.  STRT must be specified for all SWF Model simulations. One value is read for every model reach.
